caption_verbatim: FIGURE 1 | Changes in hemodynamic parameters during tilt test 1 day before dry immersion (B-1), during dry immersion (DI7, DI14, and DI19) and during the recovery period (R1 and R5). (A) Systolic arterial pressure, SAP; (B) diastolic arterial pressure, DAP; (C) mean arterial pressure, MAP; (D) pulse arterial pressure, PAP; (E) heart rate, HR; (F) stroke volume, SV. Data are given for a group of 10 subjects (Mean +/- SEM).
